terms.definition: The fist-sized organ that filters blood and helps the immune system.
terms.function: Recycles blood cells, stores cells, and fights germs.
terms.whereItIs: Under the ribs on the left side.
terms.whyItMatters: It keeps the blood healthy and defends the body.

terms.definition: The spleen's breaking down of old red blood cells.
terms.function: Salvages iron and other parts for reuse.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets the body rebuild its blood supply.

terms.definition: The spleen's role in spotting and responding to germs in the blood.
terms.function: White blood cells there fight germs.
terms.whyItMatters: It adds a layer of defense against infection.
